evidence.scope: The Harberger AMM v4 hook source at the exact reviewed revision: the afterInitialize precommit binding, the custodied full-range position with self-priced share claims, the continuous Harberger tax rebated to LPs, the permissionless buyout and liquidation, and the mandatory quadrant-dependent Programmable volume-fee accrual held separately from the tax reserve.

Stateful invariant suite over a four-actor random interleaving of deposit, withdraw, buyout, liquidate, harvest, top-up, poke and warp: the hook quote balance stays at or above the tracked tax reserve, and the tracked custody liquidity equals the real v4 position liquidity.

The single-use atomic launcher source: it deploys the token and hook as CREATE2 children, initialises the canonical dynamic-fee pool, seeds one full-range position through the hook's own custody deposit, and returns residual balances to the launch wallet.
The exact builder submission model used to recompute the mandatory Programmable volume-fee projection, the derived hook permission mask, and the four-quadrant fee-collection paths.
The fixed-supply ERC-20 token source minted once to the launcher in its constructor, with no owner, minter, pauser, blacklist, transfer tax, or upgrade path.

The mandatory-fee unit suite: the fixed 10-bps platform basis across all four swap quadrants, executed-not-requested basis, owner-only claim authorisation, no cross-pool netting, and solvency reconciliation.
